message.content: This is the **manga details/info screen** (or manga page) in a manga reader app. The UI displays the manga’s progress (Chapter 36 of 48), key stats (48 chapters, 245 MB size, English language), a description, genre tags (Action, Fantasy, Supernatural), and related manga recommendations. A prominent “Continue” button at the bottom allows resuming reading, with navigation icons (menu, grid, bookmark) and a “Set to Private” option in the top bar.
